Filename:
time_aware_recommendation_system.py

Short Description:
This project implements a sophisticated, time-aware recommendation system tailored for subscription-based services. It leverages Pandas for data manipulation, Alternating Least Squares (ALS) for collaborative filtering, and incorporates drift adjustment techniques to account for evolving user preferences over time. The system is designed to provide personalized recommendations by analyzing user-item interactions, temporal patterns, and adjusting for concept drift, ensuring relevance and accuracy in dynamic environments.

Problem Domain:

  • Recommender Systems
  • Time-Series Analysis
  • Concept Drift in User Preferences
  • Subscription-Based Service Optimization

Use Cases:

  • Personalized content recommendations for streaming platforms.
  • Subscription box service product suggestions.
  • Dynamic pricing strategies based on user engagement trends.
  • Churn prediction and retention strategies for subscription services.

Frameworks and Libraries Used:

  • Pandas: Data manipulation and analysis.
  • NumPy: Numerical computations.
  • SciPy: Sparse matrix operations.
  • Implicit: ALS model for collaborative filtering.
  • Matplotlib/Seaborn: Data visualization.
  • Scikit-learn: Evaluation metrics and model validation.
"""
Project Title: Time-Aware Recommendation System for Subscription Services using Pandas, ALS, and Collaborative Filtering with Drift Adjustment
Project Reference: ai-ml-ds-Lz9Xv3kQpRt
Filename: time_aware_recommendation_system.py
"""

from typing import List, Tuple, Dict
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares
import datetime

# Configuration Parameters
ALS_FACTORS: int = 64
ALS_REGULARIZATION: float = 0.05
ALS_ITERATIONS: int = 20
MIN_INTERACTIONS: int = 5
DRIFT_WINDOW_DAYS: int = 30


# Load Dataset (Mocked: Replace with actual)
def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zygmuntz/goodbooks-10k/master/ratings.csv")
    df = df.rename(columns={"user_id": "user", "book_id": "item", "rating": "rating", "timestamp": "timestamp"})
    df["timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["timestamp"], unit='s')
    return df


# Time-Based Weighting Function
def time_decay_weight(timestamp: pd.Series, current_time: pd.Timestamp, half_life_days: float = 15.0) -> pd.Series:
    delta: pd.Series = (current_time - timestamp).dt.total_seconds() / (3600 * 24)
    weights: pd.Series = 0.5 ** (delta / half_life_days)
    return weights


# Prepare Data for ALS
def prepare_matrix(df: pd.DataFrame, decay: bool = True) -> Tuple[csr_matrix, Dict[int, int], Dict[int, int]]:
    df = df.copy()
    user_mapper: Dict[int, int] = {uid: i for i, uid in enumerate(df["user"].unique())}
    item_mapper: Dict[int, int] = {iid: i for i, iid in enumerate(df["item"].unique())}
    df["user_index"] = df["user"].map(user_mapper)
    df["item_index"] = df["item"].map(item_mapper)

    if decay:
        now: pd.Timestamp = df["timestamp"].max()
        df["weight"] = df["timestamp"].apply(lambda x: time_decay_weight(pd.Series([x]), now)[0])
        df["value"] = df["rating"] * df["weight"]
    else:
        df["value"] = df["rating"]

    matrix: csr_matrix = csr_matrix((df["value"], (df["item_index"], df["user_index"])))
    return matrix, user_mapper, item_mapper


# Train ALS Model
def train_model(matrix: csr_matrix) -> AlternatingLeastSquares:
    model: AlternatingLeastSquares = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=ALS_FACTORS, regularization=ALS_REGULARIZATION, iterations=ALS_ITERATIONS)
    model.fit(matrix)
    return model


# Recommend for a single user
def recommend_items(model: AlternatingLeastSquares, user_id: int, user_mapper: Dict[int, int], item_mapper: Dict[int, int], N: int = 10) -> List[int]:
    if user_id not in user_mapper:
        return []
    user_index: int = user_mapper[user_id]
    item_inverse: Dict[int, int] = {v: k for k, v in item_mapper.items()}
    recommendations: List[Tuple[int, float]] = model.recommend(user_index, model.item_factors.T, N=N)
    recommended_items: List[int] = [item_inverse[item_id] for item_id, _ in recommendations]
    return recommended_items


# Evaluate Model (Optional)
def evaluate_model(model: AlternatingLeastSquares, matrix: csr_matrix) -> float:
    preds = model.item_factors @ model.user_factors.T
    truth = matrix.toarray()
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(truth.flatten(), preds.flatten()))
    return rmse


# Main Driver
def run_pipeline() -> None:
    df: pd.DataFrame = load_data()
    df = df[df.groupby("user")["user"].transform("count") > MIN_INTERACTIONS]

    matrix, user_mapper, item_mapper = prepare_matrix(df)
    model = train_model(matrix)

    # Example Use Case
    sample_users: List[int] = list(user_mapper.keys())[:3]
    for uid in sample_users:
        recs: List[int] = recommend_items(model, uid, user_mapper, item_mapper, N=5)
        print(f"User {uid} recommendations: {recs}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_pipeline()
